svg.title: From a job to an ordered graph of actions
svg.desc: Simplified: one retrieve job, no other trays. The action graph is the output; the steps execute it.
svg.metadata: ["Input: one job, retrieve the vehicle on tray T17 at bay B21. Output: the action graph below, two lanes, one per machine. The next steps execute it.", "Bay B21 switches to retrieve mode. It has no predecessor, so it can start at once, in parallel with AGV-1's first drive.", "AGV-1 drives from waypoint W26 to stall P17 and stops under tray T17.", "AGV-1 lifts tray T17 with the vehicle on it.", "AGV-1 carries tray T17 to bay B21. This action waits for two predecessors: the lift, and the bay switching to retrieve mode.", "AGV-1 lowers tray T17 in bay B21.", "Bay B21 hands the vehicle over to the customer, after the lower. Every action ran when its predecessors were complete; no clock was needed."]
